name: omp-turn-timestamps
description: Native Oh My Pi plugin that adds compact per-turn and optional per-tool timestamps directly to existing tool cards without adding them to model context.

omp.name: Turn Timestamps
omp.description: Adds per-turn timestamps and optional tool_call-to-tool_result timings directly to existing tool cards.

showTurnTiming.description: Show absolute start/end timestamps and elapsed time for each OMP turn, attached to the final tool card when possible.

showToolTiming.description: Show tool_call-to-tool_result start/end timestamps inside each existing tool card.
